content: Microsoft Copilot will no longer show its emotive yellow blob, Mico, when you use the chatbot’s voice mode. In a support page, Microsoft says it’s going to move Mico to its Learn Live platform, where the avatar will have “more to react to,” as reported earlier by GeekWire. Mico launched in Copilot’s voice mode last October, with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman pitching the avatar as a way to give the chatbot an “identity.” The blob would react to what you say in real-time, complete with facial expressions and animations. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZfJ0OXVDPE] Mico joins the long list of virtual helpers that Microsoft has retired over the years, like Clippy, Cortana, and Rover. “Mico helped us learn about warmth, expressiveness, and how people want to talk with AI,” Microsoft’s support page says. “Those learnings are shaping Copilot going forward.” Microsoft is removing Mico from Copilot “in waves.” The change is part of Microsoft’s plans to merge its Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot apps. It also comes just months after an AI reshuffling that put Jacob Andreou in charge of Copilot, while Suleyman turned his attention to developing new AI models.
chineseTitle: 微软类似 Clippy 的 Mico 角色不再是 Copilot 的面孔

chineseContent: 当您使用聊天机器人的语音模式时，Microsoft Copilot 将不再显示其情绪化的黄色斑点 Mico。据 GeekWire 早些时候报道，微软在支持页面中表示，它将把 Mico 转移到 Learn Live 平台，在那里，虚拟形象将有“更多的反应”。去年 10 月，Mico 推出了 Copilot 语音模式，微软 AI 首席执行官 Mustafa Suleyman 称该化身是赋予聊天机器人“身份”的一种方式。该斑点会实时对你所说的话做出反应，并伴有面部表情和动画。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZfJ0OXVDPE] Mico 加入了微软多年来已经退役的一长串虚拟助手的行列，比如 Clippy、Cortana 和 Rover。微软的支持页面称：“Mico 帮助我们了解了温暖、表达力以及人们如何与人工智能交谈。” “这些经验教训正在塑造 Copilot 的未来。”微软正在“一波又一波”地将 Mico 从 Copilot 中移除。这一变化是 Microsoft 合并其 Copilot 和 Microsoft 365 Copilot 应用程序计划的一部分。就在几个月前，人工智能重新洗牌，雅各布·安德烈欧 (Jacob Andreou) 负责副驾驶，而苏莱曼 (Suleyman) 将注意力转向开发新的人工智能模型。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
